metadata.question: Does forest cover in the Madre de Dios region of Peru decrease in 2018 compared to 2013?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Madre de Dios region, Peru (approximate center: -11.5°S, -70.5°W) - Time periods: 2013 vs 2018 (full year comparisons) - Dataset: Landsat 8 for both years (Landsat 8 operational from 2013 onwards) - Use NDVI or tree cover products to detect forest 2. Masking strategy: - Yes, mask clouds using QA_PIXEL band for Landsat 8 - Forest pixels: NDVI > 0.6 or use Hansen Global Forest Change dataset for better accuracy 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - C1: If no images found for either year - C2: If after cloud masking, no valid pixels remain - C3: If forest cover calculation returns None/NaN - A: If forest cover decreased (2018 < 2013) - B: If forest cover increased or stayed same (2018 >= 2013) I'll use Hansen Global Forest Change dataset which is more reliable for forest cover analysis. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Madre de Dios region const madreDeDios = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-72.5, -13.5, -68.5, -9.5]); // 2. Use Hansen Global Forest Change dataset const hansen = ee.Image('UMD/hansen/global_forest_change_2023_v1_11'); // Get forest cover in 2000 (baseline) const forestCover2000 = hansen.select('treecover2000'); // Get loss year band (values 1-23 for years 2001-2023) const lossYear = hansen.select('lossyear'); // 3. Calculate forest for 2013 and 2018 // Forest in 2013: areas with >30% tree cover in 2000 that hadn't been lost by 2013 const lossBy2013 = lossYear.lte(13).and(lossYear.gte(1)); const forest2013 = forestCover2000.gt(30).and(lossBy2013.not()); // Forest in 2018: areas with >30% tree cover in 2000 that hadn't been lost by 2018 const lossBy2018 = lossYear.lte(18).and(lossYear.gte(1)); const forest2018 = forestCover2000.gt(30).and(lossBy2018.not()); // 4. Calculate forest area for both years const pixelArea = ee.Image.pixelArea(); const forestArea2013 = forest2013.multiply(pixelArea).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: madreDeDios, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const forestArea2018 = forest2018.multiply(pixelArea).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: madreDeDios, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); // Get pixel counts for validation const count2013 = forest2013.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: madreDeDios, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const count2018 = forest2018.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: madreDeDios, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); // 5. Get results const area2013 = forestArea2013.get('treecover2000').getInfo(); const area2018 = forestArea2018.get('treecover2000').getInfo(); const pixels2013 = count2013.get('treecover2000').getInfo(); const pixels2018 = count2018.get('treecover2000').getInfo(); // 6. Validation and answer if (area2013 === null || area2018 === null) { console.log("Calculation failed - null result"); console.log("C3"); return; } if (pixels2013 === 0 || pixels2018 === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels found"); console.log("C2"); return; } // Convert to km² const area2013_km2 = area2013 / 1e6; const area2018_km2 = area2018 / 1e6; const change = area2018_km2 - area2013_km2; const percentChange = ((change / area2013_km2) * 100); console.log(`Forest 2013: ${area2013_km2.toFixed(0)} km² (${pixels2013} pixels)`); console.log(`Forest 2018: ${area2018_km2.toFixed(0)} km² (${pixels2018} pixels)`); console.log(`Change: ${change.toFixed(0)} km² (${percentChange.toFixed(2)}%)`); if (area2018 < area2013) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
